assessment_kind: Retrospective claim-based synthesis of existing receipts; no new formal execution or independent adjudication
metric_timing: The original 674-obligation allocation and fixture oracles predate their recorded executions. This synthesis defines descriptive measures before interpreting them here; it does not retrospectively invent statistical success thresholds or claim a newly pre-registered experiment.
aggregation_policy: No weighted score, global PASS percentage, semantic-correctness probability or sum of unlike evidence units. Missing evidence stays unestablished; zero reviewed groups gives undefined acceptance, not 0% or 100% correctness. Ontology size and taxonomy shape are inventory descriptors, not semantic quality.

framework_decisions.candidate: Riskium's existing semantic-assurance plan and coverage contract
framework_decisions.basis: Use the already declared formal, explicit-data, meaning, source, applicability, query, operational and reproducibility axes. Keep their distinct denominators and acceptance proposals; no universal scientific thresholds.

The inspected repository explicitly has no frozen quality core or approved canonical metric/threshold/weight set. It can inform future work; citing it does not certify Riskium or create an OQF adoption/conformance result.
framework_decisions.inspected: Mission; VVEAA research questions; Current boundaries and nonclaims; checked 2026-10-23. No full framework or catalog assessment.

framework_decisions.candidate: Taxonomy-only metrics and external composite quality schemes
framework_decisions.basis: Counting classes, subclass links or depth cannot adjudicate case identity, source meaning, dependency, record history or intended-use adequacy. No external scoring scheme was implemented, benchmarked or silently adopted by name.
framework_decisions.source: Local adoption decision; no uninspected external scheme is represented as implemented

metric_definitions.name: Conceptual inventory
metric_definitions.numerator: Count concepts, typed core, optional boundaries, imported anchor, associations, generalizations and constraints separately
metric_definitions.denominator: None; counts are not a quality ratio
metric_definitions.interpretation: Inventory only; no size or taxonomy-based quality ranking

metric_definitions.name: HermiT obligation coverage
metric_definitions.denominator: All 295 HermiT rows; retain NOT_RUN and other outcomes
metric_definitions.interpretation: Scoped formal coverage of the reviewed encoding, not domain truth

metric_definitions.name: HermiT case agreement
metric_definitions.numerator: Case outcomes matching the declared oracle
metric_definitions.denominator: All cases in the pinned HermiT receipt
metric_definitions.interpretation: Finite fixture agreement; distinct from baseline obligation coverage

metric_definitions.name: SHACL obligation coverage
metric_definitions.denominator: All 359 SHACL rows, with PARTIAL and NOT_RUN separately retained
metric_definitions.interpretation: Scoped module coverage; no arbitrary full-profile admission or semantic-validity percentage

metric_definitions.name: Synthetic CQ answer agreement
metric_definitions.numerator: Executed non-mutation cases with exact oracle agreement and no engine error
metric_definitions.denominator: All non-mutation answer cases in the CQ receipt
metric_definitions.interpretation: Synthetic retrieval evidence, not held-out real-case accuracy

metric_definitions.name: Query mutation sensitivity
metric_definitions.numerator: Successfully executed controls detecting the changed answer
metric_definitions.denominator: All declared query mutants; errors never count as detection
metric_definitions.interpretation: Sensitivity to these mutants, not a universal mutation or semantic score

metric_definitions.name: Original CQ population execution
metric_definitions.numerator: Contracts executed on the population actually declared by their source
metric_definitions.denominator: Eight original CQs; distinguish five synthetic tasks from three independently prepared populations
metric_definitions.interpretation: Population execution coverage; no acceptance of all eight original population contracts

metric_definitions.name: Public trace completeness
metric_definitions.numerator: Rows with complete public source/evidence accounting
metric_definitions.denominator: 12 requirements + 8 scope obligations + 8 CQs = 28; eight scope rows are outside the 674 baseline
metric_definitions.interpretation: Trace completion, not full requirement acceptance

metric_definitions.name: Independent semantic review completion
metric_definitions.numerator: Groups with a recorded independent adjudication
metric_definitions.denominator: 295 core groups; separately report 4 boundary and 20 original acceptance groups
metric_definitions.interpretation: Recorded review progress, not percent correct; original 20 acceptance groups do not include eight later scope traces

metric_definitions.name: Independent semantic acceptance
metric_definitions.numerator: Accepted groups under a predeclared reviewer protocol
metric_definitions.denominator: Actually adjudicated groups; undefined if zero or no approved rating interpretation
metric_definitions.interpretation: Do not invent accepted labels, confidence intervals or overall correctness

metric_definitions.name: Source interpretation evidence
metric_definitions.unit: Selected source, reading locator or interpretation row, reported separately
metric_definitions.denominator: No exhaustive source universe or independent acceptance denominator established
metric_definitions.interpretation: Editorial traceability only; NOT_ASSESSED and access limits remain explicit

metric_definitions.name: Independent case applicability
metric_definitions.unit: Independently specified real/held-out case or CQ task
metric_definitions.denominator: Not established by the current public receipts
metric_definitions.interpretation: NOT_ESTABLISHED; the approved 11 source scenarios are not automatically organizational RiskCases

metric_definitions.name: Operational preservation
metric_definitions.denominator: No reconciled public operational acceptance population established here
metric_definitions.interpretation: NOT_ESTABLISHED; native OWL and supplementary CQ fields do not imply a tested relational implementation

metric_definitions.name: Reproducibility and publication
metric_definitions.unit: Version-bound receipt or historical release check
metric_definitions.denominator: Report each receipt's own scope; do not combine release commands, software regressions and scientific cases
metric_definitions.interpretation: Historical reproduction and publication evidence; this synthesis does not rerun their engines or audit the manuscript

The later #8 corpus now identifies exact inspected portions and uninspected scope; no full clause compatibility or independent acceptance is inferred.
Keep public identity continuity separate from unavailable pre-public acquisition inventories; source-corpus closure adds no private-ID reconciliation.
This report adds versioned claim/denominator synthesis, not independent acceptance of the entire quality requirement.

judgment.reason: No independent semantic adjudications, held-out task acceptance or reconciled operational evaluation are established; formal and normative gaps remain explicit. Unknown criticality is not zero critical findings. No new universal release gate or quality threshold is imposed by this report.
